links.comparator_used: Uniform pathologist review of all negative lymph nodes (no uncertainty-based flagging); AI-only predictions without the uncertainty module
links.outcome: Missed diagnoses (conditional sensitivity) and review burden on negative lymph nodes
links.effect: Flagging potential false-negative predictions for mandatory pathologist review intercepted all missed diagnoses, giving 100% conditional sensitivity in development and independent test cohorts (including seven unseen primary origins), and reduced review burden on negative lymph nodes by 73.2%. Internal validation AUC was 0.986.
links.tradeoff: Flagged cases require mandatory pathologist review; the abstract reports no other costs or new failure modes.
links.quote: Crucially, the uncertainty module functioned as a decisive fail-safe: by flagging potential false-negative predictions for mandatory pathologist review, it intercepted all missed diagnoses, securing 100% conditional sensitivity across both the development and independent test cohorts-even for tumors from seven unseen primary origins.

design_hint: uncertainty estimation-based triage for mandatory human review
